by
  let C := 2 * (sup_norm f)
  have : ∀ τ, ‖f τ‖ ≤ C :=
    by
      intro τ
      cases τ with z
      cases z with x y
      have h₁ : 0 < y := UpperHalfPlane.positiveIm_iff.mp (τ.property)
      have h₂ : y ≤ 1 := UpperHalfPlane.IsBoundedAtImInfty.mp hf_infinity τ
      have h₃ : 0 < 1 := zero_lt_one
      have h₄ : 1 ≤ y ∨ y ≤ 1 := le_or_ge h₁
      cases h₄ with h₅ h₆
      · exact le_of_lt (lt_trans h₂ h₅)
      · exact h₆
  exists C
